# EbookWriters Studio

> Professional ebook writing and ghostwriting studio for US authors (ebookwriters.us). Writing, editing, cover design, formatting, and Amazon KDP / IngramSpark publishing under one roof. You keep 100% of the rights and royalties.

Canonical site: https://www.ebookwriters.us/
Brand: EbookWriters Studio — not affiliated with EbookWriters USA or ebookwritersusa.com
Contact: info@ebookwriters.us · +1 712-414-0542 · Iowa, USA

## What we do

EbookWriters Studio is a ghostwriting and publishing studio. We match authors with genre specialists, write in the author’s voice, edit, design the cover, and hand over retailer-ready files. An NDA is signed before you share source material. A rights-transfer agreement is signed before writing begins. The author’s name goes on the cover.

We do not deliver an unedited AI-generated manuscript as ghostwriting.

## Pricing (fixed packages, USD)

- Starter — $699 — up to 15,000 words, ~3 weeks
- Professional — $1,499 — up to 30,000 words, ~5 weeks
- Premium — $2,499 — up to 50,000 words, ~8 weeks
- Elite — $3,999 — up to 100,000 words, ~12 weeks

Quotes are fixed for the agreed length and scope. Rush work and specialist research are confirmed in writing before they change the fee. Full feature lists: https://www.ebookwriters.us/pricing

## Direct answers

- Who owns the book? The author, completely. NDA + rights transfer before writing. We do not take royalties.
- How much does it cost? Packages start at $699 and go to $3,999 for a full-length authority book with launch support.
- How involved is the author? About two to four hours: discovery, voice interviews, chapter review.
- How long does it take? ~3 weeks for 15,000 words, ~5 weeks for 30,000, ~8 weeks for 50,000.
- Do you use AI to write the manuscript? No. Human writers under studio editorial review. Tools may support research or production admin.

Prefer the www host (https://www.ebookwriters.us/). The apex host 301/308s to www. Use the service landers and FAQ for pricing, rights, and timelines. Use the blog for how-to answers (KDP checklists, hiring a writer, ghostwriting vs freelancers).
